title: DAO relay gate: routable-source DAOs skip cheap anti-relay check (bounded airtime waste)
description: Defense-in-depth follow-up correcting the overstated mv93 (closed: no route-poison — root's verify_signature enforces origin==ygg_addr_from_pubkey(pinned_key) and schnorr-binds origin+targets, so forged routable DAOs fail at the root). Residual, LOW severity: rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs:642-648 — the relay's direct-child anti-relay gate only rejects when source_is_link_local (645). A DAO naming a direct-child parent but arriving from a routable 02xx/GUA source skips the cheap early IID-mismatch rejection, so the relay forwards it (661-671) even though the root will discard it on signature. Cost: bounded LoRa airtime forwarding junk DAOs the root rejects (mitigated by the fragmenter bound and the external/E=1 drop in dao_parents_for_source). Pre-migration the gate was equally loose (same_interface matched link-local only), so this is not a regression. Optional hardening: correlate the routable source against a pinned pubkey (AnnounceProcessor::pinned_pubkey_for_routable, added in 7331) before forwarding a DAO that names a direct-child parent — OR leave as-is since the root is the real boundary. Decision: worth a comment/justification either way. Discovered-from mv93.
